answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment rather than mere computational effort. An attacker attempting to cultivate a vast garden of fake identities incurs an prohibitive economic cost because they must lock capital, which functions as the ferrous core of the network's security. Without this staked collateral, the influence of a single entity is diluted across the broad ocean of honest participants, rendering sybil attacks financially irrational.
